name: Crepes
notes: Serve for breakfast/dessert with whipped cream, berries, nutella, nuts, sour cream-lemon-sugar. Or use for main dish crepes (ham and asparagus with hollandaise; chicken, onion, sliced almonds, cheese with marinara).

steps.title: Blend the batter
steps.body: Blend in blender: **3 cups flour**, **6 eggs**, **3 cups milk**, **4 Tbsp oil**, pinch of salt, **⅔ cup sugar** and **1 tsp lemon/oj/rind**.

steps.title: Cook the crepes
steps.body: Cook in crepe pan or on griddle.
